description:
Standalone Maven plugin that produces a CycloneDX SBOM only. It
    enumerates dependencies via whatever mechanism is native to Maven: the
    resolved project dependency graph, the resolved plugin/build-tooling
    graph, and the BOM import declarations - then writes them out as a
    CycloneDX SBOM. No Gradle awareness, and no vendor/EOL/CVE annotation
    logic lives here; this module has no dependency on scanner-core or any
    other module in this reactor.
